column1: # MIK-8014: every fn on the tools/call path files -> the per-call timing row that covers it, or - with a reason.
# Part 1 of 2 (meta/router rows). Companion part: per_call_stages_stdio.tsv (src/gateway/server/ rows). Both parts are required; the checker reads them together.
# The http_invoke rows time a whole HTTP gateway_invoke end to end, and the stdio rows a whole stdio call, so a function on those paths is inside them.
# A "-" reason starting "on-path, untimed" is a per-call production cost the harness does not exercise; it is not a claim that the cost is zero.
